pr_title: feat(): Add modules options autocomplete to medusa config

comments.body: The changeset leaves out `@medusajs/fulfillment` and `@medusajs/cache-inmemory`. This PR changes both: `packages/modules/fulfillment/src/index.ts` and `src/types/index.ts` get the `declare module "@medusajs/types"` block, and `packages/modules/cache-inmemory/src/types/index.ts` gets the same block. Without a changeset entry, neither package gets a version bump. The fulfillment and in-memory cache options autocomplete will therefore not be in the next release. Add both packages as `patch` entries.
